nphi.title: GHPP Colombia – WHO Tricycle AMR surveillance
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Colombian partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Implements the WHO Tricycle protocol to measure antimicrobial resistance (ESBL E. coli) across humans, animals and the environment, to detect AMR faster; also relevant for the Caribbean Netherlands.

nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK); Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Instituto Butantan; LSHTM; Erasmus MC; ITM Antwerp; Universidad del Valle; Swiss TPH
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 consortium researching Zika virus complications and building a sustainable Latin American research network for emerging-disease preparedness. NPHI-type partners include Fiocruz, Cuba's IPK and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: ZIKAlliance – A global alliance for Zika virus control and prevention
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP Mexico); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Institut Pasteur; Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social; Universidad Industrial de Santander; Institut Louis Malardé (French Polynesia); Bernhard-Nocht-Institut
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 multidisciplinary consortium of 50+ partners studying Zika virus natural history, pregnancy outcomes and vector control across Latin America and the Caribbean. NPHIs from Brazil, Mexico, Norway and France took part.

nphi.title: COACTION – AMR cooperation Colombia–Netherlands
nphi.with: Prospectiva; Dutch Embassy in Colombia; Utrecht University; Royal GD
nphi.summary: Mapped antibiotic use and resistance actors in Colombia, compared them with the Dutch approach, and explored ways the two countries could cooperate on AMR policy.

nphi.title: Andean Health and Climate Change Plan 2026–2031
nphi.with: Health ministries of the six Andean countries; PAHO/WHO
nphi.summary: A subregional plan, approved in Lima in June 2026 and presented at the PAHO Directing Council, to help Andean health systems anticipate and respond to climate-related health risks through sector leadership, surveillance and evidence, and…

nphi.title: INS Colombia – US health security cooperation (STRIDES)
nphi.with: US Department of State; STRIDES programme
nphi.summary: US-funded health security cooperation with INS focusing on zoonotic threats, AMR, laboratory strengthening and surveillance/communication systems, continued from 2025 via the STRIDES implementing programme.

nphi.title: CDC South America Regional Office (SAMRO)
nphi.with: Brazil Ministry of Health – Secretariat of Health and Environmental Surveillance (General Coordination of Public Health Laboratories); Pará State Health Secretariat; Ecuador FETP
nphi.summary: Established in 2020 in Brasília, SAMRO supports surveillance modernisation, lab quality (SLIPTA/SLMTA with Brazil's lab network), FETP (Ecuador) and outbreak response (dengue, Oropouche, avian influenza) across South America.

nphi.title: COVIGEN/RESVIGEN – Regional Genomic Surveillance Network for respiratory viruses
nphi.with: Regional sequencing labs: Fiocruz; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; Inciensa; InDRE; Gorgas; University of the West Indies; US CDC
nphi.summary: PAHO network created in 2020 with eight regional sequencing laboratories, mostly national public health institutes, supporting countries to adopt routine genomic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2, influenza and RSV.

nphi.title: REDSUR – South American Field Epidemiology Network
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia (coordinator); TEPHINET; national FETPs of member countries
nphi.summary: REDSUR, the South American network of FETPs created in 2011 with CDC support, is coordinated by Colombia's INS, which hosted CDC and TEPHINET to plan expansion of field epidemiologists across the region.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: FETP Colombia at the Instituto Nacional de Salud
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia
nphi.summary: Colombia's FETP, hosted by the national public health institute INS, was launched with CDC support in 1992; its advanced level was accredited by TEPHINET in 2018.

nphi.title: Multicentric project on territorial health inequalities
nphi.summary: Fiocruz leads a US CDC-funded project on territorial health inequalities in five Latin American countries. IANPHI reports it under its Social and Public Health Inequalities Committee.

nphi.title: China CDC – INS Colombia technical exchange
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia
nphi.summary: First bilateral video meeting between the two institutes, framed as the start of cooperation on surveillance, emergency preparedness and laboratory capacity. No formal agreement is mentioned.

nphi.title: INS Colombia–INS Peru technical alliance on antimicrobial resistance surveillance
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Perú; PAHO
nphi.summary: Under the bilateral cooperation agreement between the two institutes and with PAHO support, INS Colombia trained INS Peru's bacteriology reference laboratory staff on AMR surveillance in healthcare-associated, vaccine-preventable invasive…

nphi.title: INS Colombia–INSPI Ecuador framework cooperation agreement and 2023 roadmap
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Investigación en Salud Pública (INSPI) Dr. Leopoldo Izquieta Pérez
nphi.summary: Framework cooperation agreement between the two national institutes, with a 2023 roadmap covering reference laboratory management, quality systems, antivenom production, surveillance and joint research and staff exchange.

nphi.title: Andean genomic surveillance exchange for El Niño-related infectious diseases (ORAS-CONHU)
nphi.with: ORAS-CONHU (Andean Health Organization); IDB; national health institutes of Bolivia, Colombia and Ecuador
nphi.summary: Under an Andean Health Organization project with the IDB, Peru's INS agreed to share diagnostic and genomic-characterisation know-how with Bolivia and Ecuador ahead of El Niño, and the four national institutes planned a regional…

nphi.title: 2022 IANPHI Latin America Annual Meeting – Declaration of Cuernavaca on Health Equity
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) México
nphi.with: NPHIs of Bolivia, Brazil (Fiocruz), Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Peru, Suriname; PAHO subregional programmes; ACTO; ORAS-CONHU; SICA/COMISCA
nphi.summary: Latin American NPHIs adopted a declaration on health equity, inequity monitoring, food insecurity, environmental crisis impacts and integrated surveillance.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – Colombia Letter of Intent on health research
nphi.with: Colombia Ministry of Health & Social Protection; Ministry of Science, Technology & Innovation
nphi.summary: Letter of Intent between India's DHR/ICMR and Colombia's health and science ministries to cooperate in health research.

nphi.title: Colombia accession to the International Vaccine Institute
nphi.actor: Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social de Colombia
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (IVI), Seoul; Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia (supporting)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Seoul in August 2021 for Colombia to join IVI, with work on COVID-19, dengue and chikungunya vaccine research and plans for local vaccine production, supported by INS Colombia.

nphi.title: Global AR Lab & Response Network – drug-resistant fungi projects with NPHIs
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia; National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC) Georgia; National Institute of Health (NIH) Pakistan
nphi.summary: Under the Global Antimicrobial Resistance Laboratory and Response Network (launched 2021), CDC funds national public health institutes in Colombia, Georgia and Pakistan to detect and track drug-resistant fungal pathogens such as Candida…

nphi.title: IANPHI Latin America Network COVID-19 exchanges
nphi.with: ANLIS (Argentina); INLASA (Bolivia); CARPHA; INS Colombia; INCIENSA (Costa Rica); INSP Mexico; INS Peru; Guyana CMO; Uruguay MoH
nphi.summary: The Fiocruz-chaired Latin American NPHI network held bi-weekly virtual meetings in 2020 to share COVID-19 responses, serology, lab quality control and kit production.

nphi.title: CDC–PAHO regional course on influenza molecular diagnostics hosted by InDRE
nphi.actor: US CDC (WHO Collaborating Centre for Influenza)
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO; InDRE (host); National Influenza Centres of participating countries
nphi.summary: International training in August 2018 at Mexico's InDRE for National Influenza Centres and laboratories of 11 countries on PCR-based influenza detection, strengthening the regional GISRS network.

nphi.title: Norway–Colombia memorandum of understanding on health
nphi.actor: Norwegian Ministry of Health and Care Services
nphi.with: Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social de Colombia
nphi.summary: Ministerial MoU signed in 2017 prioritising rural primary health care, policies on problematic drug and alcohol use, and health technology benefit decisions, alongside health workforce and mental health.

nphi.title: Regional Center of Excellence in chronic disease research (planning)
nphi.with: US National Cancer Institute; Harvard School of Public Health; Universidad Hispanoamericana; Instituto de Cancerología (Guatemala); Instituto Nacional de Cancerología (Colombia)
nphi.summary: INSP-led planning of a regional centre of excellence for cancer and diabetes research with the US NCI and Central/South American cancer institutes, including a joint mortality-database study.

nphi.title: CDC–IANPHI partnership for NPHIs
nphi.with: IANPHI; WHO/Europe (Ukraine)
nphi.summary: Since 2011: planning support for Zambia's NPHI (2015), consultation for Burkina Faso's institute (2018), an assessment of Ukraine's Public Health Center (2019) and Staged Development Tool workshops in several countries.

nphi.title: RINS/UNASUR – Network of National Institutes of Health of South America
nphi.with: ANLIS Malbrán; INLASA; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; INSPI Ecuador; LACIMET Paraguay; INS Peru; DLSP Uruguay; INH Rafael Rangel
nphi.summary: Network of ten South American national health institutes created in 2010 under the UNASUR Health Council, using structuring cooperation for exchange, training, institutional strengthening and joint projects, including joint work with…

nphi.title: PHAC/IDRC–INS Colombia chronic disease surveillance project in Pasto
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia; International Development Research Centre (IDRC, Canada)
nphi.summary: An IANPHI project in which Colombia's INS partnered with PHAC and Canada's IDRC on chronic disease surveillance and research in Pasto.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: CDC–INS Colombia cooperation agreement (community surveillance, data modernisation)
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia
nphi.summary: Under a cooperation agreement running to 2025, CDC (South America regional office and an NPHI lead for Colombia) worked with Colombia's INS on community-based surveillance, information systems, One Health, lab surveillance and data…

nphi.title: CDC–INS Colombia joint Zika research
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia
nphi.summary: A CDC delegation worked with Colombia's INS to prioritise five Zika research projects and diagnostic technology transfer, review protocols and draft a joint work plan during the 2016 Zika epidemic.

nphi.title: INS Colombia – US CDC joint Zika research
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (zoonotic and emerging infectious diseases group)
nphi.summary: INS and a US CDC expert delegation prioritised five joint Zika studies and diagnostic technology transfer under a presidential-level bilateral agreement, drafting a joint work plan.
